findings.title: build_payout_batch() emits a zero-amount entry for a currency with no payouts
findings.body_markdown: `build_payout_batch()` seeds every currency's batch with a placeholder entry (line 13) and never removes it, so a currency with no payouts produces a zero-amount instruction that the bank rejects for the whole file.
